name: Aura French Organic Linen Shirt
fit: Relaxed Regular Fit with curved hem
fabric_feel: Crisp, lightweight, and exceptionally breathable. It softens gracefully with each wash.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold gentle cycle, line dry in shade, warm steam iron while damp.
season: Summer and hot, humid tropical climates
transparency: Semi-opaque (Crisp White pairs best with nude or light undershirt)
styling_tips: Pairs effortlessly with relaxed chinos, linen shorts, or unbuttoned over a white crew tee.

name: CloudSoft Heavyweight Cotton Tee
fabric_feel: Substantial heavyweight feel with a silky brushed peach-skin surface. Thick yet breathable.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold inside-out, tumble dry low, warm iron if needed, do not bleach.
styling_tips: Looks best half-tucked into straight-leg denim or paired with cargo trousers and sneakers.

name: FlexMotion 4-Way Stretch Chino Pant
fit: Slim Tapered Ergonomic Fit with hidden flex waistband
fabric_feel: Clean tailored look on the outside with a super smooth, frictionless inner finish.
stretch: High 4-way active stretch (retains shape without bagging at the knees)
care_instructions: Machine wash warm inside-out, tumble dry gentle, low iron.
season: All-season smart casual, office wear, and active travel
styling_tips: Wear with a crisp linen shirt for business casual or an oversized tee for weekend outings.

name: Zari Mulberry Silk Festive Kurti
material: 80% Pure Mulberry Silk, 20% Fine Chanderi Cotton with woven antique gold Zari borders
fit: Straight Calf-Length Festive Cut with side slits
fabric_feel: Featherlight, regal drape with a rich festive luster; lined with breathable mulmul cotton for skin comfort.
care_instructions: Dry clean only recommended to preserve delicate gold Zari sheen.
transparency: Opaque (includes built-in soft cotton slip lining)
styling_tips: Accessorize with temple jhumkas, metallic gold mojris, and matching silk cigarette pants.

name: Merino Wool Ribbed Knit Cardigan
fit: Cozy Relaxed Cardigan Fit with tortoiseshell horn buttons
fabric_feel: Ultra-soft and completely itch-free. Naturally temperature-regulating and moisture-wicking.
care_instructions: Hand wash cold with wool-friendly detergent, reshape and dry flat in shade, do not wring.
season: Autumn, winter, and air-conditioned indoor spaces
styling_tips: Layer over a tee or drape casually over shoulders for an elevated minimalist aesthetic.
